description: Source code for the TiffEntry class, handling TIFF tag data types, validation, and string representation within the Android image utilities.

classes.name: TiffEntry
classes.description: Represents a TIFF tag entry with methods for type validation and string conversion.

methods.name: forceValidType<sp<TiffIfd>>
methods.description: Validates and returns a pointer to a sub-IFD type if valid for the given TIFF type.

methods.name: forceValidType<uint8_t>
methods.description: Validates and returns a uint8_t data pointer if valid for the given TIFF type.

methods.name: forceValidType<int8_t>

methods.name: forceValidType<uint32_t>

methods.name: forceValidType<int32_t>
methods.description: Validates and returns an int32_t data pointer if valid for the given TIFF type.

methods.name: forceValidType<double>
methods.description: Validates and returns a double data pointer if valid for the given TIFF type.

methods.description: Validates and returns a float data pointer if valid for the given TIFF type.
